text: The DeepSWE v1.1 leaderboard shows 113 tasks, updated September 3, 2026, with Models (21/28) and a current Best roster.
DeepSWE uses mini-swe-agent, 91 repositories, 5 languages, contamination-free original tasks, and behavioral verifiers.
The DeepSWE changelog adds GPT-6 Astra on September 3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash on September 1, and records reruns and pricing corrections for earlier models.
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1.1 uses nine evaluations: GDPval-AA v2, tau3 Banking, Terminal-Bench v2.1, SciCode, AA-LCR, AA-Omniscience, Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, and CritPt.
Artificial Analysis v4.1 upgraded GDPval to v2, Terminal-Bench Hard to Terminal-Bench v2.1, and tau2 Telecom to tau3 Banking, and removed IFBench because of saturation.
Artificial Analysis v4.1.1 changed grading for HLE, AA-LCR, and AA-Omniscience and used GPT-5.6 Luna medium for those grading updates.

The v1.4 AA extraction has complete 21 of 21 coverage for GDPval-AA v2, tau3 Banking, Terminal-Bench v2.1, SciCode, AA-LCR, HLE, GPQA Diamond, CritPt, Omniscience Accuracy, Omniscience Non-Hallucination, Intelligence Index, and AA evaluation cost.
Numeric speed coverage is 20 of 21 because GPT-6 Astra is missing a numeric speed value; the v1.4 score drops Speed and preserves the missing value as null.
The v1.4 parser decodes the currentModel object from first-party page payloads instead of searching visible labels, preventing a benchmark version such as v2.1 from being read as a score.
The ValueRank v1.4 score retains 21 models, 13 zero-gap dimensions, and no neutral fills; Speed is the only dropped candidate dimension.
The current ValueRank top five are Gemini 3.8 Flash at 69.4, GLM-5.3 Flash at 65.6, GPT-5.6 Sol at 61.3, GPT-6 Astra at 61.0, and Grok 4.6 at 60.8.
The ValueRank cost composite averages the normalized Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index evaluation cost and normalized DeepSWE average cost per task, with lower composite cost treated as better.

Supplemental coverage is incomplete for fields such as MLCR, Harvey, APEX-Agents, MMMU-Pro, AnalystAgent, AutomationBench, EnterpriseOpsGym, ITBench SRE, and Briefcase, so those fields remain outside the primary score.
Legacy IFBench, Terminal-Bench Hard, and tau2 Telecom are not mixed into v1.4 because current Artificial Analysis v4.1.1 replaced those benchmark identities with current definitions.
The Artificial Analysis data API documents benchmark, pricing, performance, and time-series routes, but the v1.4 refresh uses public first-party pages without placing an API key in the repository.
